name: supersend
description: B2B sales outreach by email and LinkedIn with SuperSend: set up sending inboxes, write and launch campaigns, work through replies, and track results.

interface.longDescription:
SuperSend runs B2B sales outreach by email and LinkedIn, from buying sending inboxes to booking meetings. Connect your SuperSend account and ChatGPT can buy and set up your sending domains and inboxes, write a campaign with you, show you exactly what it will send, and launch it only when you say so. Every day it brings you the replies that need an answer, drafts responses for you to approve, and tells you how each campaign is doing.

What you can do:
- Buy sending domains and inboxes: ChatGPT plans look-alike domains (never your main domain) with a few Google, Outlook or SMTP inboxes each and gives you a checkout link. Bought inboxes arrive set up, connected and warming up, with nothing else to configure.
- Or bring your own: connect inboxes you already have, and see what's still missing in your account.
- Write and launch: build a short email sequence with your offer and proof, see the full draft before anything is created, send test emails to your own inbox, then launch after you confirm.
- Work through replies: see new replies from your contacts (bounces and auto-replies are left out), read a thread, send a reply you approved, label it, and mark it done.
- Track and fix: replies, bounces, interested leads and meetings per campaign and per step, plus deliverability checks for your inboxes and domains.

SuperSend asks before anything that contacts people or costs money: launching a campaign, sending a reply, running a placement test, or buying domains and inboxes. It is built for responsible business outreach to people you have a reason to contact: every campaign has an opt-out, unsubscribes and blocklists are honored, and bounce protection and sending limits are on by default.
